items.name: TableTalk | Attendees unassigned after cutoff
items.expression: max by(service_name)({otel_metric_name="tabletalk.event.unassigned",service_name="tabletalk-api",k8s_cluster_name="tabletalk",deployment_environment_name="radar"}) > $__threshold and on(service_name) max by(service_name)({otel_metric_name="tabletalk.event.cutoff_timestamp",service_name="tabletalk-api",k8s_cluster_name="tabletalk",deployment_environment_name="radar"}) > 0 and on(service_name) (time() - max by(service_name)({otel_metric_name="tabletalk.event.cutoff_timestamp",service_name="tabletalk-api",k8s_cluster_name="tabletalk",deployment_environment_name="radar"})) > 120 and on(service_name) (time() - max by(service_name)({otel_metric_name="tabletalk.event.snapshot_timestamp",service_name="tabletalk-api",k8s_cluster_name="tabletalk",deployment_environment_name="radar"})) < 120

annotations.summary: TableTalk has {{ $value }} attendees without a published assignment
annotations.description: Enrollment cutoff passed more than 2 minutes ago and attendees remain absent from the published plan. Drafts are not published assignments. Check host state and matching errors; produce and review a current draft before publishing. Do not silently reseat attendees. A fresh snapshot is required; absent metrics do not trigger this check.

A published table contains exactly one person. Normal matching validation should prevent this. Investigate stored plan integrity and release history. Require organizer approval before changing any published assignment; do not dump attendee profiles into logs or agent prompts.

annotations.summary: TableTalk rejected {{ $value }} invalid seating plans since matcher restart
annotations.description: Seating invariant validation rejected a generated plan. No assignments were returned for that attempt. Investigate matching.build_plan traces and matcher errors. This check intentionally stays failed while the current matcher process has any rejected plans; fix the defect and deploy a corrected matcher. Ordinary user-input/layout 409 errors are not counted.

annotations.summary: TableTalk automatic matching failed at the current cutoff
annotations.description: The stored automatic-match outcome for the current enabled cutoff is failed and no plan is published. Inspect the host page for the recorded reason. Automatic matching does not retry the same cutoff: an organizer must review and recover manually. Failures for old cutoffs or disabled automation do not trigger this check.

Available replicas stayed below desired replicas for at least 1 minute. Inspect rollout, readiness, pod events, and logs in namespace team-tabletalk. A brief Recreate rollout can cause a temporary gap. Never scale the API above one replica: its mutation coordination is process-local.

annotations.summary: TableTalk is reporting an outdated assignment-health snapshot
annotations.description: Recently received measurements report a last successful assignment snapshot more than 2 minutes old, sustained for 1 minute. This detects a stuck snapshot refresh while telemetry is still arriving. Absent metrics or no measurements received within 2 minutes do not trigger this check. Check the API background loop and Elasticsearch access. A quiet check does not prove everyone is seated.

Successful saved runs exceeded a provisional 30-second p95 threshold over 15 minutes, with at least 3 observations in the window. Tune this threshold from your normal runs before enabling. Inspect affinity, enrichment, optimizer, and persistence timing. Failed or still-running attempts are not included; this is not a request-availability SLO.
